messages.text: Map the chain from a Semiconductor market requirement to a measurable parameter and then to a required capability of Oscilloscope.

已查到可引用的部分資料：

| Chain step | Mapped item | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Semiconductor market requirement | AI servers pull chip-side PMIC demand and rack/system-side power semiconductor demand; power semiconductor demand is driven by power-architecture upgrades, especially 800V high-voltage architecture specification upgrades. | [36][7] |
| Measurable parameter / validation need | For high-speed PCB/PCBA signal-integrity flow, the listed validation items include IL, Xtalk, Eye diagram, and TDR Impedance; for power integrity, PDN impedance is a named topic. | [15][34] |
| Required Oscilloscope capability | The source maps Interface Test to scopes, BERTs, AWGs, and switch matrices, and maps Power Distribution Network testing to scopes and network analyzers. | [15] |
【推論】AI-server-driven PMIC / power-semiconductor demand and 800V power-architecture upgrades can be mapped to Power Integrity / PDN impedance validation, because the passages identify those market drivers and separately identify PDN impedance / Power Integrity plus PDN testing with scopes and network analyzers. [36][7][34][15]
【推論】For semiconductor high-speed digital interface validation, the measurable parameters can be IL / Xtalk / Eye diagram / TDR Impedance, and the oscilloscope capability needed is participation in Interface Test and PDN test workflows, because the source directly lists those validation items and maps Interface Test and PDN blocks to scopes. [15]

DCP-Config-r16 › 來源列出的相關欄位
[[Wake Up Signal]] 在描述 [[DCI format 2_6]] 時列出多個與 DCP / WUS 相關的 r16 欄位或參數：

- `ps-RNTI-r16`：對應 [[PS-RNTI]]。
- `ps-Offset-r16`：來源文字為 `ps-Offset-r16*0.125ms`，與 WUS search space relative to on-duration DRX cycle 的 timing 有關。
- `duration`：來源說 search space spans `duration` slots。
- `sizeDCI-2-6-r16`：DCI2_6 total length。
- `outsideActiveTimeConfig-r16`：for each UE defines the starting position of its bits inside the whole DCI。
- `ps-WakeUp-r16`：UE does not detect DCI 時的 default behavior，wake up 或 stay asleep。
- `ps-TransmitPeriodicL1CSI-r16`：on-duration cycle does not start 時仍可 transmit periodic L1-RSRP reports 的設定線索。
- `ps-TransmitOtherPeriodicCSI-r16`：on-duration cycle does not start 時仍可 transmit other periodic CSI reports 的設定線索。

NR sample rate › 使用限制
- 來源是 lossy markdown derivative，sample-rate tables 部分排版受損。
- `currently unrealistic, not really needed and ignored for now` 未標示主體；不能直接當成 3GPP normative rule。
- `maximum bandwidth` 表格不是完整 allowed channel bandwidth matrix；allowed carrier bandwidth / SCS combinations 仍需查 [[3GPP TS 38.101-1]] 與 [[3GPP TS 38.101-2]]。

功率半導體概念股 › 限制與不可推論事項
- [[Power IC - Power Management IC image 1]]、[[Power IC - Power Management IC image 3]] 與 [[Power IC - Power Management IC image]] 都未標示圖片發布日期；[[Power IC - Power Management IC image 4]] 只在漲價潮段落標示 2026 年，仍缺少完整發布日期。
- 來源未提供量化市場數字；此頁不推論市占率、營收、排名、出貨量、成長率或供應比例。
- 「概念股」與資訊圖語境不等於公司之間存在供應、採購、合作、投資或客戶關係。
- [[Power IC - Power Management IC image 3]] 的「GaAs/Ga 通訊射頻供應鏈」照原文記錄，不自行補成 GaN 或其他技術名。
- [[Power IC - Power Management IC image]] 的「上游基板與晶晶」照 raw OCR 保留；需與既有「上游基板與磊晶」並列待查。
- [[Power IC - Power Management IC image 4]] 的 [[微碁]] 字樣清晰度有限，需待確認。
- [[Power IC - Power Management IC image 4]] 的「2026 年低票失衡引發漲價潮」照 raw OCR 保留，不自行改寫成供需失衡。

台半
[[台半]] 是 [[Power IC - Power Management IC image 1]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）列於「功率半導體概念股」表中的公司名稱，圖上代號為 5425。

DCP-Config-r16 › unresolved
- 需要補 DCP-Config-r16 在正式 [[3GPP TS 38.331]] 中的 ASN.1 definition、field descriptions 與 release version。
- 需要釐清 `physicalCellGroupConfig`、[[DRX]]、[[PS-RNTI]] 與 [[DCI format 2_6]] 的完整配置關係。
- 需要回查 `ps-TransmitPeriodicL1CSI-r16` 與 `ps-TransmitOtherPeriodicCSI-r16` 的 exact behavior。

Radiated Spurious Emissions › RSE 與 EIRP / TRP
依 [[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]]：

- [[R&S ELEKTRA]] 支援 3D [[EIRP]] evaluation：量測 Effective Isotropic Radiated Power instead of field strength。
- 5G FR2 來源多以 [[TRP]] method 表示 test requirement。
- ETSI 301 908-25 draft 來源描述 two-step method：先用 EIRP coarse grid 找 spurious frequencies，再對 EIRP above limit 的 frequencies 執行 TRP fine grid。
- Final measurement 可計算 2-cut TRP、3-cut TRP；若 limit exceeded，另執行 full TRP。

Juergen Meyer › 來源中的列名
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz verifies Next Generation eCall for EN 17240_2024 Standard]]：

- 人名：Juergen Meyer。
- 組織：[[Rohde & Schwarz]]。
- 職稱：Vice President Market Segment Automotive at Rohde & Schwarz。
- 引言主旨：他表示 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 很高興與 [[Qualcomm Technologies]] 合作驗證其 chipsets 的 NG eCall implementation，並稱此 collaboration 為 future emergency call services 設定 new benchmark，為 automotive industry 提供 robust and dependable solution 以 meet latest eCall standards。

LTM TTCN-3 Test cases- ss stack Requirements Analysis › 重點摘要
本來源是 Rohde & Schwarz confidential 文件《LTM TTCN-3 Test Cases - SS Stack Requirements Analysis (IWD_26wk24)》，標示 Generated: 2026-06-26，Source: IWD_26wk24 TTCN-3 codebase，整理 [[L1-L2 Triggered Mobility]]（LTM）TTCN-3 test cases 對 [[SS Stack LTM Requirements]] 的能力需求。來源列出 Total LTM Test Cases: 17，涵蓋 [[RACH-based LTM]]、[[RACH-less LTM]]、[[NR-DC]] LTM、[[Carrier Aggregation]] LTM，以及 [[RLC]] / [[PDCP]] persistence、NoResetID、DRX、CFRA、T304、LBT failure 等測試子集合。

| 245.76 MS/s | 200 MHz | 8 | 245760 | 4.069 ns |

| 983.04 MS/s | 800 MHz | 2 | 983040 | 1.017 ns |
| 1966.08 MS/s | 1600 MHz | 1 | 1966080 | 0.509 ns |

同一來源也說：

- Samples rates above 491.52 MS/s are currently unrealistic, not really needed and ignored for now。
- Lowest sample rate 30.72 MS/s was chosen to reduce development effort。
- 30.72 MS/s is also the standard sample rate of LTE。
- All bandwidths below approximately 25 MHz can use 30.72 MS/s。

answer.text:
| Chain step | Mapped item | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Semiconductor market requirement | AI servers pull chip-side PMIC demand and rack/system-side power semiconductor demand; power semiconductor demand is driven by power-architecture upgrades, especially 800V high-voltage architecture specification upgrades. | [36][7] |
| Measurable parameter / validation need | For high-speed PCB/PCBA signal-integrity flow, the listed validation items include IL, Xtalk, Eye diagram, and TDR Impedance; for power integrity, PDN impedance is a named topic. | [15][34] |
| Required Oscilloscope capability | The source maps Interface Test to scopes, BERTs, AWGs, and switch matrices, and maps Power Distribution Network testing to scopes and network analyzers. | [15] |
【推論】AI-server-driven PMIC / power-semiconductor demand and 800V power-architecture upgrades can be mapped to Power Integrity / PDN impedance validation, because the passages identify those market drivers and separately identify PDN impedance / Power Integrity plus PDN testing with scopes and network analyzers. [36][7][34][15]
【推論】For semiconductor high-speed digital interface validation, the measurable parameters can be IL / Xtalk / Eye diagram / TDR Impedance, and the oscilloscope capability needed is participation in Interface Test and PDN test workflows, because the source directly lists those validation items and maps Interface Test and PDN blocks to scopes. [15]
